note: Designer tiers copy (docs/DESIGNER_TIERS_SPEC.md, delivery step 2): the Kid / Builder / Engineer switch, the Kid Why? cards, the speed bar and the X-ray view. Kid wording: one or two short sentences, no digits or jargon in a Why card. A row may carry a "locked" card (the mission fixes the control) or a "hydrogen" card (the top stage burns hydrogen); they replace the one hint line. Read by Kestrel.Core.Designer.DesignerTierText. The Builder and Engineer chips stay hidden until data/features.json turns on designer.tierBuilder / designer.tierEngineer.
switchHint: How much detail the designer shows.

rows.text: Methane gets a little more push out of each bit of fuel. Kerosene is heavier, so more of it fits in the same tank.
An empty tank is dead weight. Two stages drop the big one halfway up, so the top part gets lighter and faster.
rows.hydrogen: The big empty stage drops off halfway up. This top stage burns hydrogen, the lightest fuel there is.

rows.text: More fuel lets the rocket speed up for longer. But fuel is heavy too, so too much makes it slow off the pad.
Boosters add extra push at liftoff, when the rocket is heaviest. They drop away once their fuel is gone.
rows.locked: This mission flies two boosters that come back and land. They add push at liftoff, so they stay on.

xray.title: X-ray
xray.pick: Tap a part to see what it does.

fairing.title: Nose cone
fairing.line: The cargo rides inside the nose cone. It keeps the air off, then splits open and falls away up high.

tank.title: Stage {n} tanks
tank.line: Oxidizer on top, fuel below. The engines mix the two to burn.

tankLanding.title: Stage {n} tanks
tankLanding.line: Oxidizer on top, fuel below. The teal band is fuel kept back for the landing.

tankSolid.title: Stage {n} motor
tankSolid.line: Solid fuel packed in a tube. Once it lights, it burns until it is gone.

interstage.title: Interstage
interstage.line: This ring joins two stages. It hides the upper engine until the stages split apart.

engines.title: Stage {n} engines
engines.line: These engines push the stage. They burn until its tanks run dry.

boosters.title: Boosters
boosters.line: Side boosters burn at liftoff for extra push. Then they drop away.

boostersLanding.title: Boosters
boostersLanding.line: Side boosters burn at liftoff for extra push. Then they drop away and fly home to land.

numbers.tank: Oxidizer {ox} t, fuel {fuel} t, dry {dry} t
